verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak skyscraper layout. The house photo and the 'Mile Construction' headline float with large empty gaps between them. The pool photo shrinks to a tiny thumbnail jammed into the bottom-left corner, and the top band is dead white. A at least keeps the pool image layered on its beige block, as in the original. B makes the pool image even smaller and adds a stray beige bar cut off at the right edge, which looks arbitrary and unbalanced.
